a.text: ...Sir, your insurance premiums for the month.
I mean, I just paid a few days ago...
Then we can only cover your prescription drug costs for the rest of the month, and the policy means you'll need to get a physical at a designated health care facility before the first of the month.
Th... They still haven't given me my loan...
I've been trying, damn it. If they'd just take my parents' deli as collateral, we'd be fine...
Sir, the payment is due tomorrow.

If you can't pay your premiums on time, then you definitely can't afford follow-up treatment. Considering your health and the social issues around it, your only option would be to move into an Infected treatment zone next month.
Don't worry. You'll enjoy even deeper discounts on health care there.

steps.text: That's a dead end. My life would be over.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Sir...? Mr. Sonny?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Are you feeling alright? I heard how hard you were breathing.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: It's okay, I'm not going to hurt you.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I came here with Dr. Silence, and your men checked us over. We're not carrying any dangerous weapons.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Sorry. I just, uh, force of habit.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: No need to apologize. I understand.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: It's always hard when the darkness creeps in.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Could you come a little closer? Body heat makes things much warmer. You won't go numb this way, even if you've got to sleep.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Where's the others?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Dr. Silence's medical drone installation has an emergency power source.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: She's inside the building right now giving Ptilopsis a health checkup, and Miss Elena's with them too.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Sam's...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: He's followed your plan. He got all the Pioneers in poorer health together, in there.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: On it.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Lemme ask you a favor. Don't tell Sam, or anyone, how I just, uh...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: You're their leader. If they thought your strength wasn't holding up at such a key moment, you could lose control of the Pioneer Team.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I'm not trying to say your team isn't united enough, but... the darkness usually has a way of pushing on variables.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You've got a mile of experience.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I'm a Bolívarian. Blackouts were pretty common back in the city I'm from.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Bolívar... there's a war there?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: We never had an easy guess for where the fires of war would stall out, back home.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Must've been hard for you. Getting yourself out of there, I mean.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: It was all thanks to my colleagues.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: The way I see it, you and your Pioneer Team are even more amazing.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Me... amazing? Hahah...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Wh-Why are you laughing?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: So those stupid company ads made it all the way down to Bolívar?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: No, I don't mean like that.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: No matter how you look at it, you got here by your own two feet. And the ones who came before you, the immigrants from Victoria, Gaul, and Bolívar...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: It's their footprints all together that lit up these wilds.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Hah... you got a way with words.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Eh? I'm just telling it like it is.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I'd always wanted to see what the famous Columbian frontier was like.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Well, you disappointed? Might be more desolate than your hometown here.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: No, Mr. Sonny, I think I've learned a lot.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: For example, the way your power lines are designed really is economical and efficient, just as Mechanist described.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Officer, the vehicle's ready.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Make sure you've got the right equipment.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: I saw them with handmade crossbows.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Let it get a little darker, then send a few drones ahead to the Pioneer living quarters. Confirm the position of every hostage and bandit.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: We follow behind, and look for a good opportunity to bust in.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Then... what about Researcher Silence and that Rhodes Island operator?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: What are you going for here?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: I'm not sure which side they're on.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Is that how you Rhine Labbers work? You've gotta pick a side first no matter what you're doing?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: We just want to ensure all problems are resolved.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: That's what we do in Defense, Officer.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: And what I do is help people.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Listen, I don't care what you guys want to do. My advice is to make sure you don't get in the way of my job either.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: So you're saying it's Rhodes Islanders who saved you?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Rhodes Island didn't just save my life in the accident, they gave me the chance to continue my education.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I'm where I am today all because Rhodes Island changed my life.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Hahah... what a nice company.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Any other time and place, I would've thought you were running a recruitment drive.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Mr. Sonny—if you do have an interest, you can absolutely send your CV to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Me, a Pioneer, and looking like a kidnapper now... handing my CV to a company as fine as you're talking about?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Pretty funny joke there.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Humble yourself all you want, but I can still tell how much potential you got as an engineer.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Not to mention your three ladies in there... They're all Infected, and they still got hired by Rhine Lab? Do you know how tough that is?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Um... yeah, they definitely are outstanding...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: No, not just outstanding. They're one in a million. Top of their fields.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You got so many Infected each year, and only the tiniest number of talents ever get 'pardoned.'

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: But Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Yeah, Mr. Greyy, you want to tell me, 'Rhodes Island never gives terms that harsh when it saves people.'

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Even if I was willing to believe you, believe your special kind of faith in the company that saved your life, believe it was ready to go against its own nature, its self-interest and treat an Infected fair and square.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You still can't tell me you're not lucky to be one of the chosen ones.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: And the saps left over, they get round up to sit and wait until they drown in the mud. Their only other chance is to try taking a few steps, face up to bigger danger, and go looking for the tiniest place where just for a moment, they can rest their feet.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Them and me... we're all in the same boat. No soul to save us. Can't even save ourselves.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Olivia, do you really think this is going to help?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Joyce's brain activity indicators have stabilized somewhat.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I've administered some intravenous nervous depressants. That used to be a routine treatment method. The effect isn't especially ideal in this case, but...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Could her attack have had some other trigger?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Isn't she still in serious danger either way?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Yes. As long as we can't treat the cause, she needs a better care environment.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: That's great... but I'm not even asking about Joyce's condition.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You let Greyy and the Pioneer leader go on patrol together.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That wasn't my decision. It was Greyy's own idea.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You're the captain.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I haven't spent as much time on the Rhodes landship as you two have, but I know how the company works, Olivia. I'm not trying to criticize you...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But if Greyy runs into trouble, or we're held up treating Joyce, you won't forgive yourself.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Do you believe Sonny would more easily trust Greyy, or us?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Is there a difference?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I recall you were unfortunate enough to catch Oripathy in a testing accident at Rhine headquarters.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Did it cross your mind at the time... that you might never be able to do research again?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Of course it did.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But the boss—I mean, Ferdinand sent a new contract right out, extending the three years to ten, and giving me a thirty percent raise.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You were Employee of the Year.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Yeah... not much of a consolation prize, right?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I mean, all the time I was getting treated at Rhodes Island, I ended up writing the director three entire conference papers.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I understand your perspective; I'm more or less the same.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm far less purely optimistic than you. I've worried about the future, and following from that, I was thankful to Parvis and Rhine Lab, for a time.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But I... I've never doubted my own abilities, nor what they could do for Rhine Lab in return.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: For us, Oripathy is a challenge to overcome; it's not going to gnaw our entire lives away.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: And that's why... Greyy can do what we can't.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Mr. Sonny, I'd like to point out, there's a kind of contradiction in what you're saying.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: For real?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: You say that the Pioneers risk it all in search of the next place to rest their feet...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: So how do you know we're not about to come across a way out?

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Sir, the building—the power's back!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: What the hell?!

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Wait, you son of a gun—that's what you were doing the whole time you were talking to me?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Mr. Sonny...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: If I hadn't run out into the darkness back then, I wouldn't ever have met the Rhodes Islanders who came before me, carrying the light.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Trust me. Sometimes, taking one more step really does mean something.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Even if... I'm already standing on the brink?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: —Even if you've already jumped off.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: We've seen you reaching out your hand. You're crying out to us for help.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: So we'll do everything we can to catch you.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: No matter what you've been through, it's far from time to give up yet.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: We've got power!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Did Greyy... do it?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Hngh...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That's a relief. Joyce is showing a reaction to the light.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Trust you to be so focused, even now.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Ladies.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Why are you back alone? Where's Greyy?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: This is the only place with power right now. He's making for the other quarters.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You don't trust me, do you?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Stay back!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Elena?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Olivia, you said he wouldn't trust us, but...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I have even less grounds to trust him.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: He tricked me and Joyce into coming here, and I've kept quiet on this the whole time... I saw more of them surrounding the labs.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: All of those Pioneers are armed!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: It's not what you think...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What do I think, huh? You said you didn't want to do anyone dirty! You mean you forgot how Dorothy's been treating you all?!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You're going to hurt her for your own selfish ends!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Is that...? Did you pull an alarm?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I've been planning to for a long time. I'm sure the police and my Defense colleagues are already on the way. They won't need any drones to pin our position now.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Much thanks to Greyy for this.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: So that's why he got the power back on...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Don't project your own gloomy mind on him.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Greyy really does want to help you, just like Dorothy and Joyce do.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Out of respect for them, I'll consider letting you off the hook.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Sir, whatever plans you had before, give them up before it's too late.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Are the drones out?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Not yet. Our people are waiting for your order.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Then tell me... what the hell is that thing shining above the site?!

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: So close. It'll all be good soon.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: That's some... goddamned beautiful light.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Is it? Thank you...

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Hahah... Got me feeling thawed out some, even, working with you here.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Just that bit left in front now, right? We'll show those megacorpers! Cut whatever you want to us, we won't take it sitting down, not while we've still got our own two hands to get things done!

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Wait, something's wrong...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Hold on a second!

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: D—Don't go any further! That light isn't my Arts!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Doc Silence.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I'd like to ask just one more time. Are you really willing to trust a Pioneer?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm a doctor, and a researcher.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm like my colleagues—

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: In that I trust the truth.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What's the deal outside?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What are they all running for? Did you—

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: No, not on my orders.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Get away from me, you bastard—!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Shit!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The police are probably here to rescue us.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: No, stay in here!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What the hell is wrong with you now—

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: My guess is, that thing's come again...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What thing?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Well, the... truth, I wanted to tell you about.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Elena, keep away from the door!

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Sir—s—sir...

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Got...ta watch... out...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Has he been hurt? Or is he... having an attack?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Stay away from him.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Your teammate is clearly in need of assistance!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Watch what's behind him—
An irregularly shaped object hangs in the air.
Its surface is exceptionally glossy, issuing gentle silver rays all about, and it hovers faintly up and down at this moment, as if following some sort of breathing pattern.
After rising up behind the Pioneer, about three seconds pass where it hangs in the air.
Then immediately, it slowly rotates its own body, as if curiously assessing every human at the scene.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This... It's...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Run!!!
